_doc: Recommended trips of the western USA, 2026-11-17. Same fields as ../trips.json; elevation and coords = where you sleep (app.inspire.build).

journeys.name: USA: the Southwest
journeys.blurb: Zion, Bryce, the arches of Moab, Monument Valley, Antelope Canyon and the Grand Canyon; Death Valley and Joshua Tree in winter.

journeys.name: USA: California
journeys.blurb: San Francisco, Yosemite and the giant sequoias, Lake Tahoe, Big Sur and the coast to Los Angeles and San Diego.

journeys.name: USA: the Pacific Northwest
journeys.blurb: Seattle, the rainforest and wild coast of the Olympic Peninsula, Mount Rainier, Portland, the Columbia Gorge and Crater Lake.

journeys.name: USA: the Wild West
journeys.blurb: Yellowstone's geysers and wildlife, the Grand Teton, Glacier National Park, Mount Rushmore and the Badlands; ski and wolves in winter.

journeys.name: USA: Colorado
journeys.blurb: Rocky Mountain National Park, the Maroon Bells, Mesa Verde's cliff villages and the Silverton train; Aspen and Vail in winter.

trips.title: The Southwest in a week: Zion, Page and the Grand Canyon
trips.why: Zion's canyon, Antelope Canyon and Horseshoe Bend, two sunsets on the Grand Canyon, from Las Vegas and back.
trips.note: All year. Spring and autumn are best; 40 °C in Las Vegas and Page in July and August, snow on the Grand Canyon rim and ice on Zion's high trails some days from December to February.

trips.title: National parks of the Southwest
trips.why: The classic circle: Zion, Bryce's hoodoos, Capitol Reef, the arches of Moab, Monument Valley, Page and the Grand Canyon.
trips.note: April-May and September-October are best. June-August is 35-40 °C in Moab, Page and Las Vegas (walk at dawn) with July-September storms that close the Narrows and slot canyons. Arches needs a timed entry April-October.

trips.title: Desert parks in winter
trips.why: The low, warm half of the Southwest: Death Valley and Joshua Tree in their good season, Sedona's red rocks, the Grand Canyon, Page and Zion.
trips.note: November to March: Bryce and the high plateaus have snow and short days, so this route stays low and warm: Death Valley and Joshua Tree are at their best, Sedona mild, the Grand Canyon South Rim open with snow on the rim some days.

trips.title: The Southwest in three weeks
trips.why: Every great park of Utah and Arizona with time to hike: Zion, Bryce, Capitol Reef, Moab, Monument Valley, Page, the Grand Canyon and Sedona.
trips.note: April-May and September-October are best. June-August is 35-40 °C in Moab, Page and Las Vegas (walk at dawn) with July-September storms that close the Narrows and slot canyons. Arches needs a timed entry April-October.

trips.title: Deserts and canyons in winter, three weeks
trips.why: A slow winter loop through the warm deserts, the red rocks of Sedona, the Grand Canyon and Zion.
trips.note: November to March: Bryce and the high plateaus have snow and short days, so this route stays low and warm: Death Valley and Joshua Tree are at their best, Sedona mild, the Grand Canyon South Rim open with snow on the rim some days.

trips.title: The Southwest at a slow pace
trips.why: Four weeks for the canyon country: long hikes in Zion and Moab, sunrises at Bryce and Monument Valley, days on Lake Powell and the Grand Canyon rim.
trips.note: April-May and September-October are best. June-August is 35-40 °C in Moab, Page and Las Vegas (walk at dawn) with July-September storms that close the Narrows and slot canyons. Arches needs a timed entry April-October.

trips.title: A winter month in the desert Southwest
trips.why: A month of mild desert days: Death Valley, Joshua Tree, Sedona, the Grand Canyon in snow, Page and Zion.
trips.note: November to March: Bryce and the high plateaus have snow and short days, so this route stays low and warm: Death Valley and Joshua Tree are at their best, Sedona mild, the Grand Canyon South Rim open with snow on the rim some days.

trips.title: California coast in a week
trips.why: San Francisco, the Big Sur cliffs, Santa Barbara and Los Angeles along Highway 1.
trips.note: All year: 14-22 °C on the coast, summer fog in San Francisco (June-August), rain on a few winter days; Highway 1 through Big Sur is sometimes closed by landslides.

trips.title: California: Yosemite, the Eastern Sierra and the coast
trips.why: San Francisco, Lake Tahoe, Mono Lake and Mount Whitney, Yosemite over Tioga Pass, then down the coast by Big Sur.
trips.note: June to October: Tioga Pass is open, so you cross Yosemite to the Eastern Sierra. The coast has summer fog (June-August); September and October are the clearest months; inland 35 °C in the valleys.

trips.title: California: Yosemite and the coast to San Diego
trips.why: San Francisco, Yosemite Valley, Big Sur, Santa Barbara, Los Angeles and San Diego.
trips.note: November to May: Tioga Pass and Glacier Point Road are closed, so the route stays west of the Sierra and on the coast. Yosemite Valley is open with snow (carry chains), waterfalls fullest April-June; rain on the coast December-March, sun in the south.

trips.title: California in three weeks
trips.why: Wine country, Tahoe, the Eastern Sierra, Yosemite and the giant sequoias, then the whole coast to San Diego.
trips.note: June to October: Tioga Pass is open, so you cross Yosemite to the Eastern Sierra. The coast has summer fog (June-August); September and October are the clearest months; inland 35 °C in the valleys.

trips.title: California and its deserts, three weeks
trips.why: San Francisco, Napa, Yosemite in snow, the coast to San Diego, then Joshua Tree and Death Valley in their good season.
trips.note: November to May: Tioga Pass and Glacier Point Road are closed, so the route stays west of the Sierra and on the coast. Yosemite Valley is open with snow (carry chains), waterfalls fullest April-June; rain on the coast December-March, sun in the south.

trips.title: All of California
trips.why: From the redwoods to San Diego: wine country, Tahoe, the Eastern Sierra, Yosemite, the sequoias and the coast.
trips.note: June to October: Tioga Pass is open, so you cross Yosemite to the Eastern Sierra. The coast has summer fog (June-August); September and October are the clearest months; inland 35 °C in the valleys.

trips.title: California in winter, a month
trips.why: Snow at Lake Tahoe, wine country, Yosemite, the coast and its cities, and the deserts of Joshua Tree and Death Valley.
trips.note: November to May: Tioga Pass and Glacier Point Road are closed, so the route stays west of the Sierra and on the coast. Yosemite Valley is open with snow (carry chains), waterfalls fullest April-June; rain on the coast December-March, sun in the south.

trips.title: Seattle, Olympic and Mount Rainier in a week
trips.why: Seattle, the rainforest and wild coast of the Olympic Peninsula, and the volcano of Mount Rainier.
trips.note: All year. July-September is dry and the mountain meadows are open; October-May is rainy on the coast and snowy at Paradise (snowshoes), still mild in the city.

trips.title: The Pacific Northwest
trips.why: Seattle, the Olympic Peninsula, Mount Rainier, Portland, the Columbia Gorge waterfalls and Crater Lake.
trips.note: June to September is the dry season: Rainier's meadows flower in late July and August, Crater Lake's rim road is open from July. Smoke from forest fires can hide the mountains some days in August.

trips.title: The Pacific Northwest in the green season
trips.why: Seattle, the rainforest at its greenest, Rainier in snow, Portland, the gorge's waterfalls full, and sunny Bend.
trips.note: October to May is the rainy season on the coast (the rainforest at its greenest) with snow in the mountains: Paradise on snowshoes, Crater Lake's rim closed, skiing at Mount Bachelor.

trips.title: The Northwest to the redwoods
trips.why: Washington's peninsula and volcano, Oregon's gorge, high desert and Crater Lake, down to the California redwoods.
trips.note: June to September is the dry season: Rainier's meadows flower in late July and August, Crater Lake's rim road is open from July. Smoke from forest fires can hide the mountains some days in August.

trips.title: The Northwest in the green season, three weeks
trips.why: Rainforest, waterfalls, Rainier in snow, Portland and Bend, then the redwoods in the rain.
trips.note: October to May is the rainy season on the coast (the rainforest at its greenest) with snow in the mountains: Paradise on snowshoes, Crater Lake's rim closed, skiing at Mount Bachelor.

trips.title: Seattle to San Francisco
trips.why: A month down the coast and the volcanoes from Seattle to San Francisco, by Rainier, Crater Lake and the redwoods.
trips.note: June to September is the dry season: Rainier's meadows flower in late July and August, Crater Lake's rim road is open from July. Smoke from forest fires can hide the mountains some days in August.

trips.title: Seattle to San Francisco in the green season
trips.why: The rainy months' month: rainforest, Rainier on snowshoes, Portland, Bend's sun and skiing, the redwoods and San Francisco.
trips.note: October to May is the rainy season on the coast (the rainforest at its greenest) with snow in the mountains: Paradise on snowshoes, Crater Lake's rim closed, skiing at Mount Bachelor.

trips.title: Yellowstone and the Tetons in a week
trips.why: The Grand Teton from Jenny Lake, the geysers and hot springs of Yellowstone, and wolves in Lamar Valley.
trips.note: May to October, when Yellowstone's roads are open; June to September is warmest. Snow possible in May and October.

trips.title: Winter in Jackson Hole and Yellowstone's north
trips.why: Powder at Jackson Hole, sleighs among the elk, then wolves in the snow of Lamar Valley and the geysers by snowcoach.
trips.note: November to April: only Yellowstone's north road is open to cars (Lamar Valley wolves, Mammoth), the geysers by snowcoach mid-December to mid-March; skiing at Jackson Hole and Big Sky; -15 °C nights. November and April are between seasons, with few services.

trips.title: Yellowstone, the Tetons and Glacier
trips.why: Two great parks of the Rockies and the Grand Teton, with the Highline Trail and Going-to-the-Sun Road to end.
trips.note: Late June to September: Glacier's Going-to-the-Sun Road is open from about July, Yellowstone and the Tetons are green, grizzlies and bison everywhere; frost on some nights, storms in the afternoon.

trips.title: Black Hills, Yellowstone and the Tetons
trips.why: Mount Rushmore and the Badlands, Cody's West, then Yellowstone and the Tetons without the summer crowds.
trips.note: May and October: Yellowstone and the Tetons are open but Glacier's high road is closed, so the route stays in Wyoming and South Dakota; snow possible, cold nights, few crowds; elk rut in late September and October.

trips.title: The Rockies in winter: Jackson Hole, Yellowstone, Big Sky
trips.why: Two ski resorts and Yellowstone's winter: wolves, frosted bison, geysers by snowcoach.
trips.note: November to April: only Yellowstone's north road is open to cars (Lamar Valley wolves, Mammoth), the geysers by snowcoach mid-December to mid-March; skiing at Jackson Hole and Big Sky; -15 °C nights. November and April are between seasons, with few services.

trips.title: The Wild West in three weeks
trips.why: Rushmore and the Badlands, Cody, the Tetons, Yellowstone and Glacier: the great parks of the northern Rockies.
trips.note: Late June to September: Glacier's Going-to-the-Sun Road is open from about July, Yellowstone and the Tetons are green, grizzlies and bison everywhere; frost on some nights, storms in the afternoon.

trips.title: The Wild West out of season, three weeks
trips.why: The Black Hills, Cody, Yellowstone and the Tetons at a slow pace in May or October.
trips.note: May and October: Yellowstone and the Tetons are open but Glacier's high road is closed, so the route stays in Wyoming and South Dakota; snow possible, cold nights, few crowds; elk rut in late September and October.

trips.title: Three weeks of Rockies winter
trips.why: Ski weeks at Jackson Hole and Big Sky, with Yellowstone's winter wildlife in between.
trips.note: November to April: only Yellowstone's north road is open to cars (Lamar Valley wolves, Mammoth), the geysers by snowcoach mid-December to mid-March; skiing at Jackson Hole and Big Sky; -15 °C nights. November and April are between seasons, with few services.

trips.title: The northern Rockies in a month
trips.why: A month for the Black Hills, the Tetons, Yellowstone and a week in Glacier.
trips.note: Late June to September: Glacier's Going-to-the-Sun Road is open from about July, Yellowstone and the Tetons are green, grizzlies and bison everywhere; frost on some nights, storms in the afternoon.

trips.title: The Wild West in May or October, a month
trips.why: Slow weeks in the Black Hills, Cody, Yellowstone and Jackson Hole, with the elk rut in October.
trips.note: May and October: Yellowstone and the Tetons are open but Glacier's high road is closed, so the route stays in Wyoming and South Dakota; snow possible, cold nights, few crowds; elk rut in late September and October.

trips.title: A winter month in the Rockies
trips.why: The Badlands and Rushmore under snow, then Jackson Hole, Yellowstone's north and Big Sky.
trips.note: November to April: only Yellowstone's north road is open to cars (Lamar Valley wolves, Mammoth), the geysers by snowcoach mid-December to mid-March; skiing at Jackson Hole and Big Sky; -15 °C nights. November and April are between seasons, with few services.

trips.title: Colorado in a week
trips.why: Denver, Rocky Mountain National Park's lakes and tundra road, and the Maroon Bells.
trips.note: May to October: Trail Ridge Road (late May-October), the Maroon Bells and Mesa Verde's tours are open; afternoon storms in July and August above the trees; aspens turn gold mid-September to early October.

trips.title: Colorado ski week
trips.why: A night in Denver, then Aspen or Vail with the hot springs pool of Glenwood after skiing.
trips.note: November to April: ski season at Aspen, Vail and Purgatory; Rocky Mountain National Park on snowshoes; Mesa Verde's cliff tours and Trail Ridge Road closed; sunny days, -10 °C nights in the mountains.

trips.title: Colorado: Rockies, mesas and the old West
trips.why: Garden of the Gods and Pikes Peak, Mesa Verde and the Silverton train, the Maroon Bells and Rocky Mountain National Park.
trips.note: May to October: Trail Ridge Road (late May-October), the Maroon Bells and Mesa Verde's tours are open; afternoon storms in July and August above the trees; aspens turn gold mid-September to early October.

trips.title: Colorado in winter, two weeks
trips.why: Snowshoes in Rocky Mountain National Park, a week skiing Aspen or Vail, Durango's train and Purgatory.
trips.note: November to April: ski season at Aspen, Vail and Purgatory; Rocky Mountain National Park on snowshoes; Mesa Verde's cliff tours and Trail Ridge Road closed; sunny days, -10 °C nights in the mountains.

trips.title: Colorado in three weeks
trips.why: All of Colorado's mountains at an easy pace, with time for the high trails.
trips.note: May to October: Trail Ridge Road (late May-October), the Maroon Bells and Mesa Verde's tours are open; afternoon storms in July and August above the trees; aspens turn gold mid-September to early October.

trips.title: Three weeks of Colorado snow
trips.why: Rocky Mountain National Park in snow, Aspen and Vail, Durango and Purgatory, the red rocks of Colorado Springs.
trips.note: November to April: ski season at Aspen, Vail and Purgatory; Rocky Mountain National Park on snowshoes; Mesa Verde's cliff tours and Trail Ridge Road closed; sunny days, -10 °C nights in the mountains.

trips.title: Colorado and the arches of Moab
trips.why: A month in the Rockies with a detour to Utah's arches between Durango and the Maroon Bells.
trips.note: May to October: Trail Ridge Road (late May-October), the Maroon Bells and Mesa Verde's tours are open; afternoon storms in July and August above the trees; aspens turn gold mid-September to early October.

trips.title: A winter month in Colorado
trips.why: A month of skiing and snowshoeing from Denver to Durango.
trips.note: November to April: ski season at Aspen, Vail and Purgatory; Rocky Mountain National Park on snowshoes; Mesa Verde's cliff tours and Trail Ridge Road closed; sunny days, -10 °C nights in the mountains.
